This failure to provide the promised benefits constitutes a deficiency in service as defined under [C1] and [C3]. final.markdown:
# Grievance regarding non-receipt of PMVBRY scheme benefits

**To:** Company grievance contact (no verified email - use the official complaint form)

You are writing to the PMVBRY scheme authorities regarding your eligibility for the 6-month employment benefit. You have stated that despite being eligible, you have not received this benefit. The letter demands the provision of the benefit or compensation within 7 days, failing which you will escalate the matter to the National Consumer Helpline.

```
To,
Company grievance contact
PMVBRY

Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Grievance regarding non-receipt of PMVBRY scheme benefits

Dear Sir/Madam,

I applied for the PMVBRY scheme under [BOOKING / REFERENCE NUMBER] on [DATE]. Despite being eligible, I have not received the benefit of 6 months of employment. This failure to provide the promised benefits constitutes a deficiency in service as defined under [C1] and [C3]. The service provided is faulty and inadequate, failing to meet the standards required by the scheme. I request the immediate provision of the 6 months of employment benefit or the equivalent [AMOUNT] as compensation for the loss suffered. Please resolve this matter within 7 days of receipt of this letter. If you fail to address this grievance, I will escalate this complaint to the National Consumer Helpline (NCH) for further action.

Yours faithfully,
[YOUR NAME]
[PHONE]
[EMAIL]
[ADDRESS]

Legal basis cited:
[C1] Consumer Protection Act, 2019, Section 2(10)–(11) — Definitions
[C3] Consumer Protection Act, 2019, Section 85 — Liability of product service provider
```

## If there's no reply
1. **Company grievance contact** (email / grievance page) — First. Complain in writing and keep proof.
2. **National Consumer Helpline (NCH)** (portal / phone / WhatsApp) — If the company does not resolve it. https://consumerhelpline.gov.in · 1915 · WhatsApp 8800001915
3. **District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission** (online filing (e-Jagriti)) — File within two years of the cause of action. https://e-jagriti.gov.in

_Information, not legal advice._
